EU Open Research Repository

How the EU Open Research Repository and its project collections have grown and been used since it opened on 20 March 2024. Usage time-series data runs from January 2024 through the incomplete month of August 2026; headline usage totals start at launch, and charts omit incomplete months or quarters.

Where available, use the controls above a chart to switch metric or change the number of rows shown. Hover for exact values, click linked bars to open matching records on Zenodo, and use Download CSV to export the chart data.

Compiled from the repository’s own records and its usage logs. Views and downloads are counted once per record or file, session and day. Reader location is inferred from the request IP address and may differ from the reader’s place of work. Usage logs do not distinguish people from automated clients; the Overview and Geography tabs explain this limitation. Figures compiled on 24 August 2026.
Field-of-research figures are inferred from grant data rather than declared on the record. The method and coverage are explained on the Overview tab.
